author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX makes history with a record-breaking $75 billion IPO, shifting focus away from Mars toward AI infrastructure and massive launch cadence. NASA reveals the all-male Artemis III crew - Randy Bresnik, Luca Parmitano, Frank Rubio, and Andre Douglas - along with major mission changes, including Orion docking tests with Blue Origin’s Blue Moon demonstrator and a regular Starship v3.

The ISS Zvezda module is leaking again, prompting NASA safe-haven procedures, while Amazon secures an FCC waiver for its Leo constellation after missing the 50% deployment milestone. We also cover Relativity Space’s Terran R stage 2 heading to Stennis, The Exploration Company’s new 180-ton Storm full-flow staged combustion engine, Stoke Space completing Nova first-stage proto-qualification, AstroForge’s DeepSpace-2 asteroid mission, China’s quiet Tianwen-2 rendezvous, and NASA’s X-59 breaking the sound barrier. Plus, the latest launches, upcoming missions, and more.
